"Encoder and Decoder Networks. The encoder and decoder networks in H-Net face unique design constraints due to their dual objectives and computational requirements. Each encoder must simultaneously (i) preserve fine-grained information for transmission to its corresponding decoder through residual connections (3), and (ii) compress inputs into chunks of richer representations for the main network. The decoder, in turn, must effectively combine coarse-grained representations from the main network with fine-grained details ..." [HNET §2.1.2 Design Principles, p.5]
